title: InfosTourisme.com sees OneRoadTrip as a promising start-up.
body:
InfosTourisme highlights OneRoadTrip.com as a standout TravelTech platform built around interactive maps and structured travel data rather than standard editorial content. With 800+ itineraries across 90+ countries and a hybrid approach combining AI with human validation, the platform targets both individual travelers and tourism professionals. InfosTourisme considers it one of the European projects worth watching closely.

https://infostourisme.com/en/tech-innovation/oneroadtrip.com-why-this-traveltech-platform-deserves-tourisms-attention/2026/
